# Protected paths — enforces L4 (Extend, don't edit).
#
# A pull request touching any path matching a pattern below must carry the
# `engine-touch` label AND justify the change in the PR body. CI fails without
# both.
#
# One extended regular expression per line, matched against repo-relative paths.
# Lines starting with # are comments and are stripped before matching.

^OpenRA\.Game/
^OpenRA\.Mods\.Common/
^OpenRA\.Mods\.Cnc/
^OpenRA\.Mods\.D2k/
^OpenRA\.Platforms\.Default/
^OpenRA\.Server/
^OpenRA\.Launcher/
^OpenRA\.WindowsLauncher/
^Makefile$
^Directory\.Build\.props$
^mods/(cnc|d2k|ts|common)/
